figurative_meaning_en: a small or insignificant amount of profit
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই ব্যবসায় লাভের গুড়ও পাওয়া যায় না।
তার কাজ থেকে লাভের গুড় মাত্রই হলো।
example_sentences_in_english: There's not even a crumb of profit in this business.
He got only scraps of profit from his efforts.
history: The idiom draws from the imagery of ants (পিঁপড়া) consuming tiny bits of jaggery (গুড়), symbolizing how even minimal profits can be eroded or are barely noticeable, rooted in everyday rural observations of food scarcity.
note: Jaggery (গুড়) is a traditional Bengali sweetener made from sugarcane, evoking rural economic contexts.
